messages.subject: CPD: Regulatory enforcement & the First-tier Tribunal - lunchtime session 2 Apr
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

Reminder that the firm's CPD lunchtime session 'Regulatory enforcement and appeals to the First-tier Tribunal' is on Wednesday 2 April, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate room. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to me if attending.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
